segments.pv33:3.1: “Kiṃ nu kāyena vācāya, manasā dukkaṭaṃ kataṃ;
segments.pv33:5.1: “Tassa me sahāyo suhadayo, saddho āsi upāsako;
segments.pv33:6.1: “‘Mākāsi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, mā tāta duggatiṃ agā;
segments.pv33:6.3: Sace icchasi pecca sukhaṃ, virama pāṇavadhā asaṃyamā’.
segments.pv33:8.1: “So maṃ puna bhūrisumedhaso, anukampāya saṃyame nivesayi;
segments.pv33:8.3: ‘Sace divā hanasi pāṇino, atha te rattiṃ bhavatu saṃyamo’.
segments.pv33:9.1: “Svāhaṃ divā hanitvā pāṇino, virato rattimahosi saññato;
segments.pv33:10.3: Divā paṭihatāva kukkurā, upadhāvanti samantā khādituṃ.
segments.pv33:11.1: “Ye ca te satatānuyogino, dhuvaṃ payuttā [dhuvayuttā (sī.)] sugatassa sāsane;
segments.pv33:11.3: Maññāmi te amatameva kevalaṃ, adhigacchanti padaṃ asaṅkhatan”ti.
